formulas.title: Genuine source geometry and minimal physical alphabet
formulas.scope: Common original W(3,s) typed global-injection model; h>=1. This defines the minimal alphabet, not an inequality about S_s.
formulas.not_implies: A count of source vertices or physical labels alone is not a GF(5) obstruction.

formulas.title: D6 ensemble probability and expectation
formulas.scope: h>=1, expectation over two independent UNIFORM COMPLETE globally injected original typed maps; M_6 is the original source six-edge matching count.
formulas.not_implies: Positive average does NOT imply \inf_{f,g}D_6>0 or \inf_{f,g}S_s=\Omega(s^6).

formulas.title: Original GQ anchor dirty-pencil identities
formulas.scope: Every fixed legal globally injected f,g; probability ONLY over uniformly sampled ORIGINAL nonincident GQ point-line pairs.
formulas.not_implies: Does not control four correlated original anchors conditional on a physical I1 template.

formulas.title: Quenched right-map exact B/A conditional identity
formulas.scope: h>=1; for each FIXED complete global right injection g, average over ONE independently drawn uniform complete global left injection f.
formulas.not_implies: No individual-f or all-f,g guarantee follows from the identity.

formulas.title: All-right-map conditional expected B/A lower bound
formulas.scope: h>=3; every fixed g, uniform random globally injected f. Implies min_g max_f lower; does NOT imply min_(f,g) lower.
formulas.not_implies: Does not establish Root Branch A or bound the simultaneous adversarial minimax.

formulas.title: Deterministic all-h five-original-point quintic charge
formulas.scope: h>=1; EVERY fixed coherent legal f,g, original six-incidence supports; quintic in constrained one-hot assignments.
formulas.not_implies: Nonnegative coefficients do not imply the polynomial has a uniformly positive minimum.

formulas.title: Exact global-injection-preserving two-label swap
formulas.scope: h>=1; global swap of assigned physical pair labels on two distinct original points u,v with same fixed g.
formulas.not_implies: One-transposition local optimality is not a global minimax or counterfamily certificate.
